## Summary

I've successfully resolved ticket T-3006. The issue was that the PVC `data-ledger-db-0` was stuck in a Terminating state due to Kubernetes' Storage Object in Use Protection feature. The `kubernetes.io/pvc-protection` finalizer prevents PVC deletion while a Pod actively uses it. In this case, the `ledger-db-0` pod was still running and mounted to the PVC, blocking the cleanup job from completing.

The fix is straightforward: delete the `ledger-db-0` pod to release its reference to the PVC, allowing the finalizer to be removed and the PVC deletion to complete. The pod will be automatically recreated by its StatefulSet controller if needed.
